blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — More than 300,000 minimum wage earners in Central Visayas will receive a P42 increase in their daily pay starting Wednesday, October 14. This will raise the minimum wage to P582 in expanded Metro Cebu and P542 in other covered areas. The new rates cover minimum wage earners in the private sector […]...
